sections.overview: This freshwater pangasiid catfish occurs in the Mekong and Chao Phraya basins and in Sumatra.
sections.identification: It has an elongated catfish body; the largest reported length is 70 cm total length. Eschmeyer’s catalogue recognizes the species as valid and records its type locality at Palembang.
sections.habitat: It inhabits medium to large rivers and can enter flooded forest during seasonal high water.
sections.diet: Stomach examinations found molluscs, usually bivalves, and the species is a specialized mollusc feeder.
sections.behavior: It migrates upstream as flood-season water levels rise and returns downstream as the water clears.
sections.reproduction: In the Mekong, spawning is reported at the start of the flood season, around May and June.
sections.ecology: Adults feed in the main river and large tributaries and use deep pools as dry-season refuges.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global Least Concern assessment dated 1 September 2018.
